message.content: Halo! Saat ini kami belum memiliki stok ukuran **XS**. Apakah Anda tertarik melihat ukuran lain (S, M, L, XL) atau produk lain? Jika Anda memberi tahu nama produk atau kategori, saya bisa bantu cek ketersediaan ukuran yang ada.

There's no mention of a specific product or store. We might ask clarifying question or provide general answer. We could say: "Maaf, ukuran XS tidak tersedia saat ini. Apakah Anda ingin melihat ukuran lain?" Or ask for product. We can also mention that we can check inventory. But we don't have inventory data. We can ask for product name. So respond politely.
